note: Index of the CoreML files modules/perception/ios/Engine/ModelRegistry.swift loads by name. Per-model manifests (<name>.json, 10-CV-TRAINING-TRACK.md section 6) arrive with the weights in D's handoff PR; the entries here are the contract the Swift registry assumes until they do. No binary weights are committed at this revision.

models.name: coco-yolo-nano
models.source: Ultralytics YOLO11n pretrained on COCO, exported format=coreml imgsz=640 half=True nms=True (10-CV-TRAINING-TRACK.md section 8)
models.licence: AGPL-3.0 (Ultralytics) — see LICENSES.md; weights are not redistributed in this repo

models.name: coco-yolo-nano-416
models.whenUsed: only if the 640 export misses the 15 fps gate on the demo phone

models.name: ped-signal-v1

input.crop: 640x640 window of the native-resolution centre band (09 section 3)

models.thresholdRule: ped_walk chosen at the lowest value keeping held-out per-frame walk precision >= 0.95; the module may raise it from device measurements, never lower it
models.source: Agent D fine-tune, 10-CV-TRAINING-TRACK.md sections 4-6; delivered as a PR into models/
models.licence: dataset licences per training/LICENSES.md — see LICENSES.md

models.name: depth-anything-v2-small

input.verify: exact CoreML input size and per-frame ms on the demo phone

models.output: relative inverse depth, unitless; 1 = nearest after the module's per-frame normalisation
models.calibration: NEAR / MID / FAR thresholds are per phone, set by walking at a wall from 4 m (09 section 5.3); defaults in ObstacleEstimator.swift
models.source: published CoreML conversion of Depth Anything V2 Small, or coremltools from the PyTorch checkpoint (10 section 8)
models.licence: Apache-2.0 expected for the small variant [verify] — see LICENSES.md

models.name: walkable-seg

input.verify: export and >= 5 fps on the demo phone

models.source: Cityscapes-class model exported to CoreML; phase-2 item, no gate depends on it

ocr.note: system request; no file in this directory. Raw text crosses the bridge; normalisation lives in src/indoor/ocrMatcher.ts
